# dsh-mini-window
**A mini-window mode for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) — install it and a floating ball pops out a real, al

ways-on-top browser window.**
**给 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）的小窗模式插件 —— 装上就有一个悬浮球，点一下弹出真正的置顶浏览器小窗。**

**Zero download · no Electron · no third-party plugins · zero impact when off.**
**零额外下载 · 不需要 Elect
ron · 不依赖任何第三方插件 · 不带参数时对主界面零影响。**
English · 中文
## English
### What it is

`dsh-mini-window` gives DSH a **mini window**. Install the plugin and a **floating ball** appears
in

the page; click it and DSH opens in a **separate, always-on-top browser window** at 520×720 —
a rea
l OS window you can move and pin over other apps.

The same layout is also reachable in-page with `?dsh-mini=1`, where the three-column UI collapses
in
to a compact single-column view styled as a floating card.

When `?dsh-mini=1` is absent, the attribute `html[data-dsh-mini]` never exists, so **every rule
is i
nert** and the official layout is untouched.
### Features
| Feature | Description |
| **Standalone mini window** | A real browser window in **app mode**: no address bar, no tab strip,

exactly 520×720. Driven via `--app=`, so **nothing is downloaded** |
| **Pin on top** | Toggle alway

s-on-top from the top bar — a real Win32 `SetWindowPos`, with the state read back to confirm |
| **F
loating ball** | Appears automatically (draggable, snaps to the nearest edge, remembers its position

). **Pure DOM.** |
| **Mini-window mode** | Open `/?dsh-mini=1` for the same compact single-column l

ayout in-page |
| **Top-bar controls** | Minimize / pin-on-top / sidebar toggle / compact float / mo

re menu (includes 80%–150% UI zoom) |
| **Does not fight the official layout** | At narrow viewports
DSH already collapses the sidebar into an overlay; this plugin **deliberately does not reimplement*

* responsive behavior |
| **Verifiable zero-impact** | With no `?dsh-mini=1` **none of the mini CSS

e behavior |
| **Verifiable zero-impact** | With no `?dsh-mini=1` **none of the mini CSS applies** |
### What you get after installing

| `dsh plugin --profile

add @a9i5k4/dsh-mini-window` | Floating ball **+ 520×720 always-on-top b

rowser mini window** |
| Extra download | **0 bytes** — it drives the Chrome/Edge you already have |

| Requirement | **Chrome or Edge installed** (Chrome preferred, Edge as fallback) |
| Not included
| Tray icon. Close the mini window and click the ball again to reopen |

Then either:

- **Click the floating ball** in the page → the 520×720 always-on-top window pops out, or
- open `ht
tp://127.0.0.1:19387/?dsh-mini=1` for the in-page mini layout.

- **With** `?dsh-mini=1` → mini-window mode
- **Without** → official three-column layout, zero impac

- **Without** → official three-column layout, zero impact
### Requirements

Chrome or Edge must be installed. If neither is found the plugin reports an **explicit error**
inste
ad of silently doing nothing. Override the path if needed:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

If `DSH_MINI_BROWSER` is set but points to a missing file, the plugin **fails explicitly** rather
th
an falling back to the default browser, so a misconfiguration is never silently ignored.
### Design decisions
**1. Why the browser, not Electron**

The earliest design shipped a separate Electron process. That costs **~235 MB of downloads** and
is

not part of the DSH plugin contract. Since a browser window is just an OS window, the plugin
instead
drives **Chrome/Edge in app mode**:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

- App mode gives an independent window **with no address bar**.
- The plugin runs a one-shot loopbac

k service that sets a session cookie and redirects to DSH,
so the mini window starts **already authe

nticated**.
- Cookies **ignore the port**, so the handoff service and DSH can use different ports.
-

The isolated profile lives under `~/.dsh/dsh-mini-window-browser` — **your own browser profile
is n

rofile lives under `~/.dsh/dsh-mini-window-browser` — **your own browser profile
is never touched.**

**Trade-off, stated honestly:** app mode keeps the **system title bar** (unlike Electron's
`frame:fa

lse`). Removing it entirely would mean shipping Electron again, contradicting the
zero-download goal

zero-download goal.

### Compatibility

- **Platform**: `web` (DSH desktop and web share the same front end)
- **Browser**: Chrome preferred

, Edge as fallback
- **Peer dependency**: `@deepseek-ai/cordis`
- **Runtime dependencies**: none (No

de built-ins only)
- **No third-party plugins required** — self-contained, loads in any DSH environm

built-ins only)
- **No third-party plugins required** — self-contained, loads in any DSH environment
### 特性
| 能力 | 说明 |

| **独立小窗** | 真正的浏览器**应用模式**窗口：无地址栏、无标签栏，尺寸恰好 520×720。用 `--app=` 驱动，**不下载任何东西** |
| **置顶** | 顶栏的图钉可切换

「钉在最上层」—— 真正的 Win32 `SetWindowPos`，**并回读状态确认** |
| **悬浮球** | 自动出现（可拖动、松手吸附最近的边、记住位置）。**纯 DOM。** |
|

**小窗模式** | 打开 `/?dsh-mini=1` 在页面内得到同一套紧凑单栏版面 |
| **顶栏控件** | 最小化 / 置顶 / 侧栏开关 / 紧凑浮窗 / 更多菜单（含 80%–150%

界面缩放） |
| **不抢官方布局** | 窄视口下 DSH 官方已把侧栏折叠成浮层；本插件**刻意不重复实现**响应式 |
| **可验证的零影响** | 不带 `?dsh-mini=1` 时小

布局** | 窄视口下 DSH 官方已把侧栏折叠成浮层；本插件**刻意不重复实现**响应式 |
| **可验证的零影响** | 不带 `?dsh-mini=1` 时小窗相关规则**一条都不生效** |
### 兼容性

- **平台**：`web`（DSH 桌面端与 Web 端共用同一前端）
- **浏览器**：优先 Chrome，退 Edge
- **peer 依赖**：`@deepseek-ai/cordis`

- **运行时依赖**：无（只用 Node 内置模块）
- **不依赖任何第三方生态插件** —— 交付物自持，任何 DSH 环境都能加载
